_comment: Skips each CI job expects (ADR-0546, docs/testing-standards.md). A Catch2 test case that skips and is not listed for the job fails the job. 'unverified' marks an entry whose runner behaviour was assumed, not observed.

landlock.test: A real Landlock ruleset denies access outside its allowlist and permits access inside it
landlock.reason: Skips when the runner's kernel or container runtime does not offer Landlock. Whether GitHub's ubuntu-latest kernel and Docker's default seccomp profile allow it has not been checked.

landlock.test: A Landlock rule for a regular file is accepted by the running kernel
landlock.reason: Skips when the runner kernel has no Landlock; availability on GitHub runners not checked.

landlock.test: Landlock ABI 6 signal scope is requested when the kernel supports it
landlock.reason: ABI 6 needs Linux 6.12; GitHub's ubuntu-latest kernel is expected to be older, not checked.

landlock.test: Landlocked production SQLite worker cannot open main's database for writing
landlock.reason: Skips when the runner kernel has no Landlock; availability on GitHub runners not checked.

landlock.test: A task is confined only when it has a seccomp filter and no_new_privs
landlock.reason: Child reports SKIP when the kernel cannot enforce the filter or Landlock; runner capability not checked.

asan.test: Live secret allocations remain independently locked
asan.reason: AddressSanitizer replaces mlock with a version that locks nothing, so kernel lock state cannot be observed (the test skips itself under ASan).

asan.test: Derived keys and their copies occupy locked allocations
asan.reason: AddressSanitizer replaces mlock with a version that locks nothing, so kernel lock state cannot be observed (the test skips itself under ASan).

asan.test: Signing box cache fails closed when its key copy cannot be locked
asan.reason: AddressSanitizer replaces mlock with a version that locks nothing, so kernel lock state cannot be observed (the test skips itself under ASan).

tsan.test: The federation worker starts and serves a request under the worker seccomp filter
tsan.reason: The worker seccomp filter does not enumerate the syscalls ThreadSanitizer needs, so the scenario skips under TSan. The test only detects TSan through __SANITIZE_THREAD__, which clang may not define: unverified for the clang TSan job.

root-container.test: The federation worker starts and serves a request under the worker seccomp filter
root-container.reason: The CI container runs as root, and a root worker fails the seccomp filter for unrelated reasons (fchown, capability bounding set); the test skips under root.

bsd.test: The federation worker starts and serves a request under the worker seccomp filter
bsd.reason: seccomp is Linux-only; the scenario skips on the BSDs.

bsd.test: merovingian-server caps the connections one client address may hold open
bsd.reason: The BSDs configure only 127.0.0.1 on loopback, so 127.0.0.2 is not a local address (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

bsd.test: merovingian-server does not cap connections from a trusted reverse proxy
bsd.reason: The BSDs configure only 127.0.0.1 on loopback, so 127.0.0.3 is not a local address (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

bsd.test: One client keeping every connection alive does not hold the workers another client needs
bsd.reason: The BSDs configure only 127.0.0.1 on loopback (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

bsd.test: One client trickling request bodies does not hold the workers another client needs, and is cut off
bsd.reason: The BSDs configure only 127.0.0.1 on loopback (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

bsd.test: Connections that never send a byte do not hold the workers another client needs
bsd.reason: The BSDs configure only 127.0.0.1 on loopback (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

bsd.test: The logger starts no thread until its writers are explicitly started
bsd.reason: The BSDs have no /proc/self/task, or it does not enumerate threads, so the thread-count check skips (not confirmed on the CI VMs).

no-smtp.test: A notification for an email pusher is mailed, as an unread count only, after the delay
no-smtp.reason: The linked libcurl was built without SMTP (RHEL's libcurl-minimal) so there is no SMTP session to test. Which runners link such a libcurl has not been confirmed.
